messages:
nora_ap: Invoice INV-4027 from Meridian Media came in referencing PO-MM-334 but line items don't match PO: PO lists 3 x social ads, invoice lists 5 x social ads + 1 video editing. AP blocked for quantity/price variance and routed to Procure.
kevin_procure: I see PO-MM-334 approved for three social ads (unit price 1,200) and no video work. Did we authorize scope change?
yasmin_eng: Engineering requested two additional social ads during campaign but didn't submit change order. We need confirmation whether to accept extras and whether to pay video costs.
paul_sales: Client asked for extra ads; sales verbally approved on 2026-06-01 but no PO amendment. Vendor claims the extra units are billable. We need written approval to pay.
vendor-bot: Meridian Media (billing@meridianmedia.com) uploaded INV-4027 (PDF) link: https://files.example.com/meridian/INV-4027.pdf
finance-bot: Automation: flagged 'po_line_mismatch' and set routing to procurement. Created task T-44120. Payment hold applied.
kevin_procure: We need either: 1) vendor reissue invoice removing unapproved items, 2) internal retroactive PO amendment + written approval from Sales (PA signed off), or 3) accept as disputed and pay approved lines only, issue dispute credit for remainder. Which path fastest?
paul_sales: I'll pull up the email thread with the vendor approving extras. If I can produce an internal approval (Sales manager + AM), procurement can create a PO amendment retroactively. Give me 3 hours.
yasmin_eng: If we approve extras, GL split needed: 3 ads -> GL 5402 (marketing), 2 extra ads -> GL 5410 (campaign experiments), video editing -> GL 6203 (third-party creative). AP will need separate line coding.
nora_ap: AP can process partial payment for approved lines if we provide line-level approvals. Otherwise we'll keep full hold. Which do you prefer?
paul_sales: Goal is to keep vendor relationship smooth. If I can confirm approvals in 3h, do PO amendment route and pay full invoice. If not, pay approved 3 ads only and dispute rest.
vendor-bot: Vendor replied: "We can split invoice if needed; prefer full payment. Happy to wait for PO amendment or accept credit note for disputed items"
kevin_procure: I'll standby for Paul's approval. If not received by EOD, we'll proceed with partial payment and raise dispute for remainder. I'll draft PO amendment template now to speed process.
finance-bot: Note: create GL split instruction when amendment posted. Task T-44121 created for AP coding.
payments_lead: Payment hold remains. If partial payment chosen, schedule for next run with line-level amounts: pay 3x1,200 = 3,600; rest disputed.
paul_sales: Uploaded email chain to invoice record confirming verbal approval from Sales Head but not signed. I requested signed confirmation. If signed approval arrives, notify procurement to create PO amendment.
nora_ap: Tracking: invoice status = awaiting_approval_docs. Last update by paul_sales at 2026-07-15T14:24Z. Will re-run match after docs uploaded.
kevin_procure: Also raising process improvement: require change-order approval in procurement portal for scope changes >1 item. I'll create PR to enforce in PO templates.
paul_sales: Understood. I'll chase AM and Legal to get signed approval.
finance-bot: Automated reminder set for 3h. If no update, AP will proceed partial pay.
nora_ap: Closing interim thread. Will update once approval docs or vendor credit note arrives.
